blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In a British office, feedback is usually gentle. If your manager says "there are a couple of small things we could look at", those small things may be bigger than they sound.

Listen for what is not said. The criticism often hides inside the praise. "That was a really good first draft" almost always means "please change a lot."

Once you learn to listen for it, British feedback is kind and honest — just in its own language. The praise comes first, but the real message comes second.

items.q: How is feedback usually given in a British office?
items.why: "In a British office, feedback is usually gentle."

items.q: Where does the criticism often hide?
items.why: "The criticism often hides inside the praise."

items.q: "A really good first draft" almost always means…
items.why: "That was a really good first draft" almost always means "please change a lot."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You should listen for what is not said.
"Small things" are always small and easy.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que as "small things" podem ser maiores do que parecem, então o autor discordaria.

items.q: The text suggests that a good listener should…
items.why: Inferência: "Listen for what is not said" — a mensagem real está nas entrelinhas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie conversando com uma colega mais nova. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
So, how did your first review go? You look a little worried. Come and sit down for a minute.

I heard your manager say your report was "a really good first draft". That sounds nice, doesn't it? But here in the UK it usually means she wants you to change quite a lot. Don't worry, it is not bad news. It is just the British way of talking.

She also said there were "a couple of small things" to look at. In this office, "small things" are often not that small. So take a good look at those points. Read them slowly. Ask her what she really means. She will be happy to explain, and she will not be cross.

The praise comes first, and the real message comes second. That is the trick. Once you learn to listen for it, the feedback is honest and kind. She is on your side. She really wants you to do well here.

So keep the praise, work on the small things, and follow up with her next week. Do that, and you will be absolutely fine.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why does Sophie start talking to her colleague?
options: The colleague looks a little worried
The colleague wants a new job
The colleague is leaving the company
items.why: "You look a little worried."

items.q: What does "a really good first draft" usually mean here?
options: The manager wants you to change quite a lot
The report was sent to a client
items.why: "...it usually means she wants you to change quite a lot."

items.q: What does Sophie say about "a couple of small things"?
options: They are often not that small
items.why: "'small things' are often not that small."

items.q: What does Sophie suggest the colleague do?
options: Ask the manager what she really means
items.why: "Ask her what she really means. She will be happy to explain."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the manager's feedback?
items.why: Inferência: "the feedback is honest and kind. She is on your side." — Sophie vê o retorno como positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Her manager gave her some feedback after the meeting." Feedback is…
options: a return of comments about your work
items.why: Feedback = retorno/comentários sobre o seu trabalho.

items.q: "The email was very kind." Kind means…
items.why: Kind = gentil, cuidadoso com o outro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This is only my first ___, so I will change many parts."
items.why: First draft = primeira versão, ainda vai mudar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I like honest people. Please be ___ with me."
items.why: Honest = honesto: dizer a verdade.

items.q: "There are just a couple of small things to fix." A couple of means…
items.why: A couple of = alguns, uns poucos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões comuns em reuniões de retorno no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "My manager will sign off on the report tomorrow." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Can you follow up with her about the small things?" To follow up means to…
options: check again and take the next step
items.why: Follow up = retomar depois, dar o próximo passo.

items.q: "I don't fully agree, so I will push back a little." To push back means to…
items.why: Push back = resistir de forma educada, discordar um pouco.

items.q: "Let's work on the small things first." To work on means to…
items.why: Work on = dedicar-se a melhorar algo.

items.q: "She always follows through on her plans." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.
